products.detail_name: Pin tay cầm for VIVE Focus Series
products.description:
Extend your virtual reality sessions with a spare headset battery. Lets you continue using your VIVE VIVE Focus Vision1 or VIVE VIVE Focus 3 while its main battery is charging. The swappable battery design enables easy charging for all-day VR headset use.

1. VIVE VIVE Focus Vision has a built-in reserve battery, allowing you to swap the VIVE Pin tay cầm for Focus Series in the rear battery case without losing power for up to 20 minutes.

products.list_name: VIVE Wired Streaming Kit (DisplayPort mode compatible)
products.detail_name: VIVE Wired Streaming Kit (DisplayPort mode compatible)
products.description:
Everything you need to connect your VR headset and computer for PC VR streaming. The kit includes a 5-meter streaming cable and full-featured converter, both with DisplayPort compatibility.

DisplayPort mode enhances the streaming experience with visually lossless graphics and remarkably low-latency data transmission.

Access more PC VR games and other graphically demanding applications.1,2

Supports VIVE VIVE Focus Vision headset.

Stay powered and immersed—pair the VIVE VIVE Focus Vision with the VIVE Wired Streaming Kit to maintain your headset's battery level for all-day PC VR sessions.3

Phụ kiện trong hộp:
VIVE Wired Streaming Cable (DisplayPort mode compatible)
• USB 3.2 Gen 2 (up to 10 Gbps) with DP 1.4 Alternate Mode support, USB-C to USB-C
• Length: 5 m

VIVE Wired Streaming Converter (DisplayPort mode compatible)
• Converter (0.7 m):
- Phím bấm & Điều khiển: USB-A, DP, Power (AC/USB)
- Output: USB-C with DP 1.4 Alternate Mode support
• USB-C-to-DP adapter
• MiniDP-to-DP adapter
• USB-C-to-USB-C cable for charging (1.2 m)
• USB-PD power adapter (30 W)

1. System requirements must be met. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. DisplayPort mode doesn't support MR.
2. Visual quality and low latency of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection.
3. The VIVE Wired Streaming Kit includes a USB-C to USB-C charging cable and a USB-PD power adapter, which maintain your headset’s battery level during wired PC VR sessions.

products.list_name: VIVE Wired Streaming Converter (DisplayPort mode compatible)
products.detail_name: VIVE Wired Streaming Converter (DisplayPort mode compatible)
products.description:
The full-featured, DisplayPort-compatible converter, paired with VIVE Wired Streaming Cable (DisplayPort mode compatible),1 connects your VR headset and computer for PC VR streaming.

DisplayPort mode enhances the streaming experience with visually lossless graphics and remarkably low-latency data transmission. Access more VR games and other graphically demanding applications.2, 3

Supports VIVE VIVE Focus Vision headset.

Phụ kiện trong hộp:
• Converter (0.7 m):
- Phím bấm & Điều khiển: USB-A, DP, Power (AC/USB)
- Output: USB-C with DP 1.4 Alternate Mode support
• USB-C-to-DP adapter
• MiniDP-to-DP adapter
• USB-C-to-USB-C cable for charging (1.2 m)
• USB-PD power adapter (30 W)

1. VIVE Wired Streaming Cable (DisplayPort mode compatible) sold separately. The standard VIVE Streaming Cable does not support DisplayPort mode.
2. System requirements must be met. VR‑ready PC required. VR headset and VR/MR titles each sold separately. DisplayPort mode doesn't support MR.
3. Visual quality and low latency of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection.

products.description:
Wirelessly connect your standalone or PC VR headset with VIVE Ultimate Tracker for an elite positional tracking experience.1

Using a proprietary low-latency 2.4 GHz connection, VIVE Wireless Dongle can pair a compatible device with up to 5 VIVE Ultimate Trackers for full-body tracking and object tracking.2

Plugs into your VIVE standalone VR headset or PC via USB Type-C.3

Compatible with: VIVE VIVE Focus Vision, VIVE VIVE Focus 3, VIVE XR Elite, and third-party SteamVR-supported headsets.

Phụ kiện trong hộp:
• VIVE Wireless Dongle
• Cable clip
• Extension cable
• Extension cradle

1. Device compatibility required. A VIVE Wireless Dongle is required to connect VIVE Ultimate Tracker with compatible devices. VIVE Ultimate Tracker and compatible devices sold separately.
2. Content compatibility required. Compatible content and devices sold separately. PC VR titles are available on VIVE VIVE Focus Vision and VIVE XR Elite via VIVE Streaming and on VIVE VIVE Focus 3 via VIVE Business Streaming. Third-party VR headsets must access compatible SteamVR content via VIVE Hub (beta). System requirements must be met.
3. For VIVE VIVE Focus Vision, VIVE VIVE Focus 3, and VIVE XR Elite, VIVE Wireless Dongle can be plugged directly into the headset for standalone VR content or PC VR content using wireless streaming. It should be plugged into the PC for PC VR content using wired streaming. For third-party SteamVR-supported headsets, VIVE Wireless Dongle must be plugged into the PC. When VIVE Wireless Dongle is plugged into the PC, VIVE Ultimate Tracker must be paired using SteamVR via VIVE Hub (support is in beta through September 2024).

products.meta_description: Enjoy seamless full-body tracking with VIVE Wireless Dongle, an adapter that wirelessly pairs standalone or PC VR headsets with up to 5 VIVE Ultimate Trackers.

products.description:
Keep your standalone VR trackers1 ready for action with this 5-in-1 docking station.

Use with a USB Type-C cable and power adapter2 to simultaneously charge up to 5 VIVE Ultimate Trackers in 3.5 hours or less.3 Storage for one VIVE Wireless Dongle is also included.4

Optimize your VR setup and make the most of full-body tracking for gaming, fitness, VTubing, and more!5

Phụ kiện trong hộp:
• VIVE USB-C Dock (5 Ports) x 1
• Quick-start guide x 1
• Safety guide x 1
• Warranty card x 1

Kích thước: 203 x 93.6 x 32.5 mm

Trọng lượng: 335 g ± 3%

Power:
Phím bấm & Điều khiển: 15 V/3 A (45 W) x 1 USB-C receptacle
Output: 5 V/1.6 A (8 W) x 5 USB-C connectors

Phím bấm & Điều khiển: 15 V/2 A or 12 V/2.5 A (30 W) x 1 USB-C receptacle
Output: 5 V/1 A (5 W) x 5 USB-C connectors

Phím bấm & Điều khiển: 12 V/2 A (24 W) or 9 V/2 A (18 W) x 1 USB-C receptacle
Output: 5 V/0.5 A (2.5 W) x 5 USB-C connectors

Phím bấm & Điều khiển: 5 V/3 A (15 W) x 1 USB-C receptacle
Output: 5 V/0.5 A (2.5 W) x 5 USB-C connectors

1. Compatible with VIVE Ultimate Tracker (sold separately).
2. A USB Type-C cable and power adapter with rating of 15 W or higher are required. Khôngt included with VIVE USB-C Dock (5 Ports).
3. Assumes use of a compatible 45 W power adapter with USB Type-C Power Delivery. Thời gian sạc is an estimate and may vary with use. Longer charging times may result with a power adapter rated less than 45 W.
4. VIVE Wireless Dongle is sold separately and does not need to be charged.
5. Theo dõi toàn thân (Full-body tracking) is dependent on VR headset, tracker, and content compatibility. VIVE Ultimate Tracker requires a VIVE Wireless Dongle to connect with compatible devices, which currently include the standalone VR headsets VIVE VIVE Focus Vision, VIVE VIVE Focus 3, and VIVE XR Elite, and third-party VR headsets that support SteamVR. Third-party VR headsets must access compatible SteamVR content via VIVE Hub (beta). System requirements must be met.
6. For VIVE VIVE Focus Vision, VIVE VIVE Focus 3, and VIVE XR Elite, VIVE Wireless Dongle can be plugged directly into the headset for standalone VR content or PC VR content using wireless streaming. It should be plugged into the PC for PC VR content using wired streaming. For third-party SteamVR-supported headsets, VIVE Wireless Dongle must be plugged into the PC. When VIVE Wireless Dongle is plugged into the PC, VIVE Ultimate Tracker must be paired using SteamVR via VIVE Hub (support is in beta through September 2024).

products.description:
The zip design of this on-the-go carrying case ensures your VIVE VIVE Focus Vision or VIVE VIVE Focus 3 VR headset and accessories stay safe.

The built-in, auto-pairing cable offers much-needed convenience. It makes charging and managing multiple headsets and controllers at the same time possible. Labeling your hardware to ensure everything matches is no longer necessary. Auto-pairing will re-sync the headset to the controllers right inside the charging case.

Phụ kiện trong hộp:
  • Cable for auto pairing
  • Zip design
  • Easy carry handle
  • Shoulder strap support
  • External charging port
  • USB cables to charge controllers
  • DC cable to charge headset
  • Storage space to fit VIVE designed AC adapters and other accessories

products.list_name: Multi Pin tay cầm Charger for VIVE Focus Series
products.detail_name: Multi Pin tay cầm Charger for VIVE Focus Series
products.description:
A 4-in-1 charger for Pin tay cầm for VIVE Focus Series.1 Simultaneously charges up to four batteries in under two hours.

Eliminate downtime and easily swap out your VIVE VIVE Focus Vision or VIVE VIVE Focus 3's battery to ensure uninterrupted, 24/7 use.2 Perfect for maximizing the length of your VR sessions.

  • Charges Pin tay cầm for VIVE Focus Series from 0% to 100% in under two hours.
  • 120 W charger ensures full-speed fast charging on all four batteries.
  • Includes a status indicator on the battery.


1. Pin tay cầm for VIVE Focus Series sold separately.
2. VIVE VIVE Focus Vision has a built-in reserve battery, allowing you to swap the rear headset battery without losing power for up to 20 minutes.

products.description:
Keep your VIVE Ultimate Trackers1 secured in place with TrackStraps by Rebuff Reality. Breathable elastic neoprene, comfortable and firm. Fits most waist sizes and foot and shoe sizes. Supports full-body tracking in VR games and applications.

The Dance Dash Game Key can be redeemed for one (1) copy of Dance Dash on VIVEPORT. Instructions for redeeming the game are printed on the game key card. Morph your VR rig into the ultimate dance floor and use your feet to stomp the beats in this pulse-pounding, full-body sensory symphony!

Includes:
• Left TrackStrap for VIVE Ultimate Tracker
• Right TrackStrap for VIVE Ultimate Tracker
• TrackStrap Belt for VIVE Ultimate Tracker
• Dance Dash Game Key

products.list_name: Deluxe Pack for VIVE XR Elite
products.detail_name: Deluxe Pack for VIVE XR Elite
products.description:
Experience enhanced ergonomics with 4 new VR accessories designed exclusively for VIVE XR Elite.

The Deluxe Pack contains one of each of the following items:

VIVE Face Gasket 2.0 for XR Series
Snug, smooth, and suited for full immersion in virtual reality. Enjoy more even pressure distribution and a velvety texture while minimizing light leakage. Wide cushion and narrow cushion included.

VIVE MR Gasket for XR Series
Get better ventilation and a more complete view of your surroundings with this sleek alternative to the default face gasket — perfect for mixed reality experiences. Features a cleanable forehead rest.

VIVE Deluxe Strap for XR Series
A back-to-front top strap that helps comfortably distribute weight between the headset unit and battery cradle. Adjust to your preferred fit for optimal balance during standalone and PC VR gameplay.1

VIVE Temple Clips for XR Series
Wear VIVE XR Elite with added stability offered by these left and right temple arm clips, which seamlessly secure the headset-to-battery cradle connection.


1. PC VR titles are available on VIVE XR Elite via VIVE Streaming. System requirements must be met. Content compatibility and VR‑ready PC required. PC VR titles sold separately. Visual quality of VR/MR content is dependent on PC specs, software settings, and network connection.
